config.selection: validation sign-hit; tie lower raw-label BCE

evaluation.decision_timestamp: panel date t, 12:00 America/New_York; non-FX builder cutoff 11:30 ET
evaluation.quotation: positive = local currency appreciation against USD; USD-per-foreign EUR/GBP/AUD/NZD, inverse other FX quotes
evaluation.zero_target: negative binary class; legacy three-way sign-hit requires exactly zero logit to hit zero return
evaluation.mean_hit: equal-weight dates and target currencies, np.sign(z)==np.sign(r)
evaluation.scaler: train-only feature mean/std, missing -> standardized zero; lag applied before scaler in conservative policy
evaluation.regimes: six causal regime indicators, thresholds from training only
evaluation.conservative_policy: FX-derived features observed at least 14 calendar days earlier; all non-FX supplied PIT features an additional panel-date lag; regimes recomputed after these lags
evaluation.conservative_limitation: 14-day schedule buffer, not per-release vintage certification; 2006-2009 H10 weekly publication interruption and subsequent revisions remain unverified
evaluation.conditional_policy: same inputs/scalers as prior exploration; current noon spot requires an unverified contemporaneous market feed
evaluation.no_graph: zero cross-currency message at training and inference; no per-node pooling or foreign-node gate; predefined common market/regime inputs and USD gauge retained
evaluation.source_fact: H10 previous-week daily rates published Mondays 16:15 ET, next business day if federal holiday; weekly release interrupted May 2006-Jan 2009
evaluation.subset_authorization: User explicitly permits exploratory choice of evaluation period and currency subset; all models share each selected denominator; all seeds retained.
evaluation.selection_caveat: Subset ranking uses report labels; descriptive selected-sample advantage, not independent generalization or selection-corrected significance.
